components.name: Play Disc
components.description: Green 56px circle that starts Popular or toggles the current track.
components.html: <button class="ds-play-disc" type="button" aria-label="Play"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" height="24" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M8 5.14v13.72a1 1 0 0 0 1.5.86l11-6.86a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.72l-11-6.86a1 1 0 0 0-1.5.86Z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-play-disc { display: grid; place-items: center; width: var(--play, 56px); height: var(--play, 56px); border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green, #1ed760); color: #0d0d0d; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1)), background 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1)); } .ds-play-disc svg { margin-left: 2px; } .ds-play-disc:hover { transform: scale(1.04); background: var(--green-hover, #3be477); } .ds-play-disc:active { transform: scale(1); background: var(--green-press, #1abc54); } .ds-play-disc:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #fff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Follow Pill
components.description: White-stroke pill that opens LinkedIn; copy flips to Following.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 3px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--text, #fff); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #fff); font-family: var(--font, Satoshi, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: var(--type-body, 0.875rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1)), background 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1)); } .ds-pill:hover { transform: scale(1.04); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 8%); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #fff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Track Row
components.description: Popular / album list row; current state turns name and index play green.
components.html: 1Mercado Libre2021 — today
components.css: .ds-track-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px 40px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font, Satoshi, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-track-row:hover, .ds-track-row:focus-visible { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 10%); } .ds-track-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-track-row.is-current { color: var(--green, #1ed760); } .ds-track-index { color: var(--text-sub, #b3b3b3); font-size: 0.875rem; text-align: right; } .ds-track-row.is-current .ds-track-index { color: var(--green, #1ed760); } .ds-track-cover { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-press, #2a2a2a); } .ds-track-name { overflow: hidden; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-track-meta { color: var(--text-sub, #b3b3b3); font-size: 0.875rem; white-space: nowrap; }

components.css: .ds-shelf-card { display: block; width: 152px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font, Satoshi, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-shelf-cover-wrap { position: relative; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-shelf-cover { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-elevated, #181818); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 50%); } .ds-shelf-card:hover .ds-shelf-cover, .ds-shelf-card:focus-visible .ds-shelf-cover { background: var(--bg-press, #2a2a2a); } .ds-shelf-play { position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green, #1ed760); color: #0d0d0d; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); transition: opacity 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1)), transform 160ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1)); } .ds-shelf-card:hover .ds-shelf-play, .ds-shelf-card:focus-visible .ds-shelf-play { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } .ds-shelf-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-shelf-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-shelf-sub { color: var(--text-sub, #b3b3b3); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; }

narrative.northStar: A Catalog That Is a Life
narrative.overview:
This is a working Spotify artist surface, not a dark résumé with a green accent. The shell is void black; the reading panes are the familiar Spotify base; the color in the room is the photograph and the album art. Green is a verb. It starts Popular. It marks the track that is on. It does not decorate the page.

The type is compact self-hosted Satoshi. Interface copy lives between eleven and sixteen pixels. The only jump to display scale is a name — the artist on the hero, the record on a song or album page. Controls do real work: Play scrolls and starts Popular, Follow opens LinkedIn, Share sends this page, EN/ES sits in the sticky top bar. Depth is tonal (void / pane / elevated) plus the drop under a cover, not glass and not a hard offset shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Black shell, pane surfaces, artwork as the chroma field
Green reserved for play and now-playing / active transport
Self-hosted Satoshi at 400 / 500 / 700 / 900; display is weight 900 only
Eight-pixel gaps and pane radii; four-pixel list covers; full pills; a 56px play disc
Listeners line is theatrical and marked (`staged` / `en escena`)

rules.name: The Play-Green Rule
rules.body: Green is a control state, not a theme. If a surface is not playing, about to play, or actively on, it is not green.

rules.name: The Artwork-First Rule
rules.body: Chroma besides play green and verified blue comes from photographs and covers. Do not invent a third accent.

rules.name: The Name-Is-the-Display Rule
rules.body: Only an artist or record name may leave the 11–16px UI band. Section heads stay at title size; they do not compete with the name.

rules.name: The Staged Listeners Rule
rules.body: The listeners sentence keeps its theatrical mark — monthly listeners · staged / oyentes mensuales · en escena. Do not style that figure as a factual KPI.

rules.name: The Tonal Shell Rule
rules.body: New surfaces join void / pane / elevated / press. Do not add a shadow to a pane, a nav, or a row.

rules.name: The Eight-and-Four Rule
rules.body: Gaps and pane radii are 8px. List covers are 4px. Pills are 999px. The green play disc is 56px. Do not invent a new radius for a new screen of this shell.

dos: Do keep Play as the 56px green disc that starts Popular, and Follow as the white-stroke pill that opens LinkedIn.
Do put the artist name at display scale on the real photograph, with Popular and Contact in the first scroll.
Do draw icons as the authored SVG set (`app-icon`); one stroke weight, currentColor except the verified check.
Do keep the listeners line marked `staged` / `en escena`.
Do collapse at 900px to the mobile artist grammar: no sidebar, stacked band, mini-player, three tabs.
donts: Don't wash a pane, hero, or section in play green. Green is the verb.
Don't substitute a system display face for Satoshi. The face is self-hosted; the stack is fallback, not the voice.
Don't introduce kickers as a reusable pattern. Section heads are the title size; they do not wear a label above.
Don't use hard-offset or zero-blur block shadows. Cover drops are soft and black only.
Don't use emoji or glyph dingbats as icons.
Don't present credentials as a résumé grid. Songs, albums, and playlists are the navigation model.
